title: Has anyone ever encountered the invaders?
content: They come in the guise of peace and technological advancement but in reality do quite a bit of human and other experimentations. The effects can be very diverse, and sometimes earth scientists think they are having wonderful breakthroughs. But it often goes very wrong eventually. And what they do with much of the population is horrific. They gather people in bus/train startions and airport terminals. The mark people through various government id efforts. It’s always too late when people start to notice, if they do.
